import re
user_msgs=[]
for raw in lines:

  idx,h0,w0,ins,outs=match.groups(); h,w=int(h0),int(w0)
  a=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in ins.strip().splitlines()]
  b=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in outs.strip().splitlines()]
  print(idx,len(a),len(b),[len(r) for r in a][:2],[len(r) for r in b][:2])
  demos.append((a,b))
